description: MainActivity.java for an Android wearable app that manages data exchange, photo capture, and communication with a paired wearable device using Google Play Services Wearable API.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing wearable data exchange, photo capture, and communication with paired device.

classes.name: DataItemAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying event logs in a list view.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event with a title and text for display.

classes.name: StartWearableActivityTask
classes.description: AsyncTask to send start activity messages to connected nodes.

classes.name: DataItemGenerator
classes.description: Runnable that periodically generates and sends data items with an incrementing count.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, views, and GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not resolving errors.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts periodic data item generation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Cancels periodic data item generation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from camera intent, updates thumbnail.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles successful connection to GoogleApiClient, adds listeners.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts, attempts resolution.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes data change events from wearable.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from wearable.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Processes capability change events.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes UI components.

methods.name: onTakePhotoClick
methods.description: Dispatches intent to take a photo.

methods.name: onSendPhotoClick
methods.description: Sends captured photo as asset to wearable.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Sends message to start activity on wearable.

methods.name: sendStartActivityMessage
methods.description: Sends start-activity message to a specific node.

methods.name: dispatchTakePictureIntent
methods.description: Starts camera activity to take a photo.

methods.name: toAsset
methods.description: Converts Bitmap to Asset for transfer.

methods.name: sendPhoto
methods.description: Sends photo asset via DataApi.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Retrieves connected wearable nodes.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: Wrapper for Log.d for debugging.
